title: Native modal dialogs make the containing document inert
claim: HTMLDialogElement.showModal() puts the dialog in the top layer and makes other elements in the same document inert, excluding the dialog and its descendants.
applicability: Native HTML dialogs in browsers and Electron renderers; an HTML caption outside the dialog is affected too.
limitations: This API reference is not Windows 95 guidance. Only the containing document is blocked; custom Electron caption and native window behavior require host checks.
